Module registry for the ferp-com Simulator UI.

Add an entry here whenever a new HsysModule is created.
The UI loads this file to populate the Source / Destination dropdowns
in the Messages tab.

'id' must match the MODULE_ID / #define used in the C++ source.

Special entries (always present, do not remove):
  id=0   BROADCAST  — message is delivered to all subscribed modules
  id=255 UNKNOWN    — placeholder when the module is not yet assigned an ID
